## Overview

**Your next move could be a big one.**

A Global MBA is about more than business knowledge. It's about seeing the bigger picture, making confident decisions and being ready to lead on real business challenges.

De Montfort University's Global MBA is designed for ambitious graduates and early-career professionals around the world who want to build towards leadership – whether that's progressing in your organisation, exploring new professional opportunities or starting a business of your own. You don't need years of management experience to get started – you need the ambition to grow and the determination to put what you learn into practice.
